versions.content: Service name: ComM_COMCbk_<sn> Syntax: void ComM_COMCbk_<sn>( void ) Service ID[hex]: 0x36 Sync/Async: Synchronous Reentrancy: Non Reentrant Parameters (in): None Parameters (inout): None Parameters (out): None Return value: None Description: This callback is called when the EIRA or ERA was updated in COM. The call only informs the ComM about ERA and EIRA changes. The actual handling is done in the next call to ComM_MainFunction_<ComMChannel.ShortName> with changing the corresponding PN State machine. Available via: ComM_Com.h
